title: Redis Caching Patterns
description: Implement caching strategies with Azure Cache for Redis to improve application performance.

data.text: Your API has 10,000 requests/minute but the database can only handle 2,000. Product catalog queries are repetitive and data changes infrequently. How do you reduce database load without redesigning the entire architecture?
Implement **Azure Cache for Redis** as a caching layer. Use **Cache-Aside pattern** for read-heavy workloads. Set appropriate **TTL policies** and handle **cache invalidation** on data updates.

data.title: C# - Cache-Aside Pattern

data.text: **Azure Cache for Redis** provides sub-millisecond latency and can handle 1M+ operations/second. It's a **PaaS service**, so you don't manage servers or patching. Redis is the industry standard for caching.
